author: Donna Wood-Dudley
text:
I'm in NC & dme,pharmacy etc All claiming that the FSL3 is in a back order stat. They get a "few" & BAM they're gone. 
I've had to revert back to the original 14day fsl. Granted gotta scan it for in time #'s  but  I can use phone app in tandem with the reader... not stuck with choosing just 1 device to pair/activate it plus it's just as reliable if you're mindful to location/ properly applying it 
The failed sensor replacement, falling off, and whatevers especially ppl using it for weight loss  kinda like ozempic & y the likes, seem to be compromising products availability
